parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: Required for idempotent scenarios. A UUID-generated string. This field is used for idempotence. If the same value is passed in multiple calls, the result of the first call is returned. If a result is returned after the call, you can parse the refund order ID, which indicates that the call is successful.

parameters.name: ImmediatelyRelease
parameters.description: Required for unsubscription scenarios. Valid values: 1: immediately releases the instance. 0: stops the instance first based on the shutdown policy. Only some products support this value. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: Required for unsubscription scenarios. The instance ID, not the custom name.

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description: Required for unsubscription scenarios. The product code. If the error code returned after the call indicates that the product is not supported, submit a ticket to request that the cloud service enable this feature.

parameters.name: ProductType
parameters.description: Required for unsubscription scenarios. The product type. Unless otherwise specified, pass an empty string. In the debugging tool, you do not need to manually enter a value. Hover over the input box, and a button labeled "Enter empty string" appears. Click this button. When initiating an unsubscription through code, pass an empty string "".
